definitions: To do something with great enthusiasm, effort, and dedication.
To invest all of one's energy and passion into a task or endeavor.
examples: She put her heart and soul into her painting, and it showed in every brushstroke.
He put his heart and soul into building his business from the ground up.
If you put your heart and soul into your studies, you'll achieve great results.
lemma: put one's heart and soul into something
source: put one's heart and soul into something
